description: Allows you to hide your presence and scent, which makes it difficult to detect you — though it can be seen through with a Diviner’s True-Sight.

name: Ring of Foundation
subtitle: Store and release Veyn
description: It is used to store any amount of Veyn and can be released back into the body to refresh the reserves of Veyn in the body.

name: Remy’s Bracelet
subtitle: Carry 10 items anywhere
description: Allows the user to store up to 10 items in the bracelet. To use, pour in your Veyn or Ren into the bracelet and think of the item you want to bring out and the item would come out; if you want to put in an item, think of the item already being inside the storage and the item would enter — all while using your Ren or Veyn to bring in or pull out items.

name: Hermes Robe
subtitle: 20x speed
description: It enhances your speed by 20 times.

name: Iron-will Ring
subtitle: Resist poison, mental attacks, and fatal injuries
description: Used to increase your resistance to poison, mental attacks, and fatal injuries. Though for the fatal injuries function, it has a year cooldown. It also has partial, though little, resistance to unstable Veyn and little resistance to the Sentient River current and pull. Required to pass safely through Lethmoor’s unstable Veyn terrain.

fields.label: Note
fields.value: Needed to pass safely through the unstable Veyn terrain around Lethmoor Kingdom.

name: Pixie Dust
subtitle: Youth, Veyn and Ren in a powder
description: Can be used to make someone younger or give a permanent boost in Veyn and a little for Ren. It is one of the core ingredients of the Alchemist class, since it reacts well with Veyn. It is quite rare and can only be gotten by going to the Hidden Realm. It can be brewed with pixie dust, grinded leaves of the Grimbough tree, grinded powder from the bark of the Ebonspire tree, and the heart of a dragon — the resulting potion is called the Ethereal Potion.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: Pixies (Hidden Realm)

name: Grimbough Tree
subtitle: The magic-resistant slanting tree
description: It is a slanting tree. Its wood is thick and strong, with a strong resistance to magic. The leaves are thin and can be grinded into dust to be used for the brewing of the Ethereal Potion.

name: Ebonspire Tree
subtitle: The 100-year tree of dragon nests
description: It is found and grows near the nest of a dragon. It is a 100-year-old tree. The leaves can be used to make an elixir named the Rejuvenating Elixir, while the bark when grinded to powder can be used in making the Ethereal Potion.

name: Ethereal Potion
subtitle: Legendary-rank elixir that halts aging
description: A legendary-rank elixir, difficult to brew correctly — a single miscalculation wastes the rare ingredients entirely. Rather than restoring or boosting Veyn or Ren, it halts the drinker’s aging completely for a long, fixed stretch of time rather than reversing it like pixie dust does.

fields.label: Ingredients
fields.value: Pixie dust, grinded leaves of the Grimbough tree, grinded powder from the bark of the Ebonspire tree, the heart of a dragon

name: Rejuvenating Elixir
subtitle: Complete healing
description: A potion that does a complete heal of the person who drinks it. Can even heal broken legs or lost arms. The version found in the vault of Lethmoor can heal the impossible, except a severed head or a missing heart past 10 minutes.

name: Vireth, the Fallen Grace
subtitle: The corrupted divine sword sealed in the Sentient River
description: Sealed within the depths of the Sentient River, held down by two separate seals rather than one, as though whoever bound it there didn’t trust a single ward to be enough. The blade itself is dark, almost absorbing the light around it rather than reflecting it, with faint cracks of dim gold light bleeding through along the fuller — like the last remnants of what it used to be before it fell. Even sealed, the water around it never fully settles; the current near it moves like something is still restless beneath the surface. Strangely, the blade doesn’t feel like something purely angelic or purely demonic — whatever corruption twisted it seems to have left behind a blade that belongs fully to neither side. Very effective against an angel or a demon; it can stop the regeneration of both races effectively unless the user releases the effect. A user bound weapon. One of the only ways to kill a Serapharch.

fields.label: Skill — Graceless Edge
fields.value: Cuts through both holy wards and demonic wards equally, treating corrupted and uncorrupted Veyn as the same thing to sever — essentially cutting magic if you have enough Veyn to cut it.

fields.label: Skill — Split Grace
fields.value: Channels both a holy (angelic) and a corrupted (demonic) aura through the blade at the same time, striking with both auras layered into one attack. Dangerous to hold even briefly; causes a force-splitting explosion of the cut area.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Depths of the Sentient River, under two seals

fields.label: User-bound
fields.value: Binds to the user’s soul — anyone else who tries to use it finds it becomes nothing more than a piece of metal.

name: Virastra, the Ascendant Vow
subtitle: The uncorrupted divine sword, lost in the ruins
description: Lost somewhere in the ruins scattered across the Hidden Realm, no longer in anyone’s possession. Unlike Vireth, its blade is untouched, still holding a clean, steady light along its edge — closer to moonlight than sunlight. Where Vireth feels heavy and restless, Virastra is said to feel almost weightless in the hand, an ease that reflects its uncorrupted nature. Being lost among ruins rather than deliberately sealed, its exact location isn’t guarded the way Vireth’s is — it’s simply forgotten, waiting for someone to stumble upon it rather than seek it out. Extremely effective against demons and halts a demon’s regeneration unless the user releases the effect.

fields.label: Weapon type
fields.value: Divine Sword

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Lost somewhere in the ruins scattered across the Hidden Realm

name: Solvane, the Hallowed Edge
subtitle: The divine spear still in someone’s possession
description: The only one of the two Divine Weapons still in someone’s possession rather than lost or sealed away. Unlike Vireth’s restless darkness or Virastra’s weightless calm, Solvane carries itself with quiet authority — its head long and narrow, more piercing than cutting, forged for a single decisive strike rather than a prolonged exchange. The metal holds a steady, clean light along its edge, similar in tone to Virastra’s, since neither has ever been corrupted — but where Virastra’s light feels ambient and calm, Solvane’s feels focused, almost gathered to a point, fitting a weapon built to be thrown or thrust with precision rather than swung. Will always return to the owner when thrown. A user bound weapon that can be passed down.

fields.label: Weapon type
fields.value: Divine Spear

fields.label: Owner
fields.value: Clint Ashborn — the current ruler of the Angel Realm.

fields.label: Notable
fields.value: Always returns to the owner when thrown; user bound weapon that can be passed down.

fields.label: User-bound
fields.value: Binds to the user’s soul — anyone else who tries to use it finds it becomes nothing more than a piece of metal.

name: Aerendrel, the Skybound Wrath
subtitle: The storm-strung bow of the Lethmoor vault
description: A unique divine-adjacent bow, said to have been strung with a fragment of storm itself rather than ordinary sinew or Veyn. Those loosed from it don’t just pierce — they carry a violent surge of raw elemental force (lightning, wind, or pressure), which detonates on impact rather than simply striking true. Unlike a standard Archer’s Veyn-enchanted arrows, which are shaped and controlled, Aerendrel’s power is closer to a contained storm — difficult to fully master, and even harder to wield without some of that raw force spilling back onto the archer themselves. It doesn’t need arrows: the bow forms arrows from the user’s Veyn. Found in the chamber beneath Lethmoor’s throne chair.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Vault of Lethmoor Kingdom (chamber beneath the throne chair)

fields.label: Note
fields.value: "Sinew" refers to a tendon — the tough, fibrous connective tissue that attaches muscle to bone.

name: Liework’s Fallen Crown
subtitle: The decayed crown of a fallen kingdom
description: Shaped like a twisted ring of black thorned vines rather than a traditional band of gold — more a wreath of dead growth than a symbol of triumph. Wherever the true crown once looked like, this is what remained after the kingdom fell: thorns in place of jewels, black in place of gleaming metal, as if the crown itself decayed alongside the throne it once sat on. Wearing it doesn’t grant strength so much as command — faint traces of the authority its last wearer held still cling to it, enough to lean on an Angelic Aura-style effect, making those weaker than the wearer more inclined to submit, though nowhere near as absolute as a true Serapharch’s presence.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Vault of Lethmoor Kingdom

name: Selene’s Luck
subtitle: One critical strike, blocked
description: A luck pendant that blocks a critical/fatal strike that can kill you once, and then breaks.

name: Auralis Ruby
subtitle: The pendant that sealed the MC’s forms
description: A pendant crafted by the MC’s mom (Lisa), who then gave it to Sofia. The pendant has 5 seals to seal the MC’s 5 forms. It seals both of his auras (angelic and demonic), which makes him look human.

name: Agro Totem
subtitle: Summon a storm of monsters
description: A totem made to attract a storm of monsters to it, make all the monsters angry, and boost the power of monsters by 10. For it to work, 2 must be made: the first is set in the monster area, and the other at the desired location — when you infuse Veyn once into the second totem at the designed location, the monsters are drawn there. It can be crafted with blood of a siren, a Lucent Stone, blood of a Veilborn, and a hay doll on a stick.

fields.label: Ingredients
fields.value: Blood of a siren, Lucent Stone, blood of a Veilborn, a hay doll on a stick

name: Jaiden Marlock
subtitle: Main Character — the first Angel-Demon Hybrid
description: A hybrid of an angel and a demon, and as a result became the first hybrid in the world. His parents were the right-hand man of the rulers of the angel and the demon realm, respectively. He was given to his mother’s personal maid, Sofia, along with the Auralis Ruby pendant to seal his auras so he looks human. He then lives in the Human Realm with Sofia.

Her rank was Bloodward. She was known to bring cruelty upon people who fight her and is the most powerful demon in the Demon Realm after the Mordrach. After realizing she was pregnant with Jaiden and found his aura very abnormal — carrying both an angelic aura and a demonic aura — she knew he would be killed off and she could not bear it, so she gave the child to her personal maid, not before giving her a ruby pendant called the Auralis Ruby to seal all his auras, which makes him look human.

description: He is the second right-hand man to Tera Morage in the Demon Realm. He had always hated Lisa for being stronger than him and holding the top Bloodward position, so he was constantly looking for a way to take her power and rank away. When he saw Sofia heading to an unknown location, he tried to follow her but lost track of her. He then saw Lisa meet with an angel. After that, he discovered they had intercourse and that she had become pregnant with a child. He used this information to report her to Tera Morage, which enraged the ruler. name: Ruby Divina
subtitle: Ruler of the Human Realm (Female)
description: Ruby Divina is the only mortal ruler in a world governed by immortals — Clint Ashborn does not age, and Tera Morage dies of nothing short of a Divine Weapon, while Ruby will be gone within a mortal lifetime and knows it. She rules humanity, the one people with no wings, no halo, no miasma — just raw Veyn and short years — caught between two realms that could crush hers on a whim. Her whole reign has been the slow, careful work of making humanity too useful and too dangerous to be worth crushing. She has known about Jaiden Marlock from the beginning — the hybrid child hiding in her realm under a maid’s care is no secret to her — and she has shielded him not from kindness but because he is her insurance: a being both realms would go to war over, the one card that could make humanity a power instead of a client.

name: Tera Morage
subtitle: Ruler of the Demon Realm — Mordrach (Female)
description: Tera Morage did not inherit the Mordrach’s crown — she tore it from the king before her, the way every Fiend who ever ruled the Demon Realm rose by killing the one above, and she has never once relaxed her grip since. Unkillable by anything short of a Divine Weapon, she let that invulnerability curdle into contempt, ruling her generals and her right-hand men with the certainty that nothing in the realm can touch her. The single exception was Lisa. Lisa was not merely her right-hand — she was her friend, the one demon Tera trusted enough to keep close — and so when Licent Varak brought her the truth of Lisa’s affair with an angel, Tera did what no Mordrach is supposed to do: she showed mercy. She demoted Lisa to Gnash, a punishment meant to hurt but not to kill, because in a realm where strength is the only truth, that was the softest sentence she could pass without appearing weak. It was still a death sentence. Licent, who had only ever hated Lisa, had her killed by his own men — and Tera, who can be killed by nothing in her realm, learned that the one law she cannot bend is the one that put her on the throne: when a Mordrach dies, all the Veyn she holds passes to the heir who can withstand it. Her court is a circle of knives, every one of them waiting for a Divine Weapon to appear, and Licent Varak, her own second right-hand, is already in the dark with Dark Moon. She does not see it, because she has spent so long fearing nothing that she has forgotten how to fear her own shadow.

name: Clint Ashborn
subtitle: Ruler of the Angel Realm — Serapharch (Male)
description: Clint Ashborn has ruled the Angel Realm so long the realm has forgotten there was ever another way. He ordered his own right-hand man, Ordium, executed for loving a demon and fathering the hybrid child — and to Clint that was not cruelty but necessity, the one clean cut that kept chaos from the door. He believes the Veyn Vow and the hierarchy are the only things standing between order and the collapse of everything, and he administers that belief with the serenity of a man who has never once doubted he was saving the world. He knows the buried truth of the world core’s will, and it frightens him more than any demon, because a will greater than the angelic order would mean the order he has upheld his whole existence is not the highest thing there is. Every impossible thing Jaiden Marlock is, is a refutation of Clint’s entire life — which is what makes him so dangerous an enemy: he is not wrong that the hybrid threatens the world’s balance, only wrong about what to do with it.

name: Lisa’s Plot
subtitle: A forbidden love, a hidden child, and a death sentence
description: Lisa (Bloodward demon) and Ordium (Aetherblade Lord Angel) fell in love despite their ranks and positions. Unable to stay together, they were separated to their various realms. After realizing she was pregnant with Jaiden and that his aura carried both an angelic and demonic aura, she knew he would be killed, so she gave the child to her personal maid Sofia, along with the Auralis Ruby pendant to seal all his auras so he looks human. Jaiden then lives in the Human Realm with Sofia.

fields.label: Plot twist
fields.value: As she returned and Sofia left to the Human Realm, Lisa was called to the chamber of the ruler’s throne room of the Demon Realm. Next to Tera Morage (on the throne) was her second right-hand man, Licent Varak, who reported to the ruler that Lisa had intercourse with an angel, which enraged Tera. Lisa was demoted to a Gnash rank and was later killed off by Licent’s men, since he had always hated Lisa.

name: Licent Varak’s Plot
subtitle: Jealousy that cost Lisa her life
description: Licent Varak, second right-hand man to Tera Morage, had always hated Lisa for being stronger than him and holding the top Bloodward position. He was constantly looking for a way to take her power and rank away. He saw Sofia heading to an unknown location, tried to follow her but lost track of her. He then saw Lisa meet with an angel, discovered they had intercourse and that she had become pregnant. He used this information to report her to Tera Morage, which enraged the ruler. As a result, Lisa was demoted to Gnash rank and later killed by his men, which he ordered them to do.

name: Ordium’s Plot
subtitle: Love at first sight — left unfinished
description: Ordium, an Aetherblade Lord Rank Angel, fell in love with Lisa at first sight. He left his post and spent the next 9 months with Lisa in a secret place in the Human Realm, since it is large and it would take time for them to be found. They were expecting a child, but unexpectedly they were called back by their rulers… (the document cuts off here — “but as…”)

name: Jaiden Marlock — Normal
subtitle: First Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: Looks fully human. No visible wings, horns, or halo.

name: Jaiden Marlock — Halo & Horns
subtitle: Third Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: A halo appears above his head and two horns emerge from his forehead, using partial abilities of both an angel and a demon.

name: Jaiden Marlock — Full Angel Form
subtitle: Second Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: 6 pure feathery white wings and a halo that glows brightly on top of his head, along with the angelic aura all angels carry.

name: Jaiden Marlock — Full Demon Form
subtitle: Fourth Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: 6 horns and 6 dark purple feathery wings, along with the demonic aura all demons carry.

name: Jaiden Marlock — True Hybrid Form
subtitle: Fifth Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: 3 pure white feathery wings on one half of his body and 3 black feathery wings on the other, 6 horns, and a halo split in half floating above his head. Both the angelic and demonic auras surround him at the same time.

name: Angel Skills
subtitle: The skills of angels
description: The abilities angels wield, drawn from their Veyn and their rank. Each angel rank has its own skills, and the Six Pillars of Angels each carry their own personal techniques. Titles also grant their own set of skills, distinct from rank abilities.

name: Kings Record
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: By making physical contact, the user can view fragments of a target's memories and past experiences. The clearer the contact and the stronger the user's focus, the more detailed the visions become.

name: Sixth Sense
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Sharpens every one of the user's senses far beyond normal limits. Sight can pierce darkness and illusion, hearing can catch heartbeats and distant footsteps, smell can track individuals across long distances, and touch can feel shifts in Veyn and emotion. At full focus, the user can perceive things that are completely invisible to the naked eye, including hidden auras, faint traces of magic, and the emotional state of those nearby.

name: Time Reversal
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Reverses the flow of time in a small area or on a single target for up to 20 seconds, undoing recent actions or injuries within that window.

name: Chronos Fury
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Calls down a concentrated storm of lightning onto a chosen location, striking with high precision and destructive force.

name: Will Mastery
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Shapes pure Veyn into any weapon the user can imagine. The formed weapons can also launch sharp blades of compressed air from a distance.

name: Holy Rain
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Summons a rain of purified holy energy that burns undead and corrupted beings while healing allies and restoring their Veyn.

name: Dignified Presence
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: The user floods the surrounding area with their own Veyn, thickening the air until it becomes heavy and oppressive. Breathing grows difficult, movement slows, and weaker opponents struggle to stay upright or form skills. The more Veyn the user pours into it, the denser and more crushing the pressure becomes.

name: Angelic Aura (Serapharch)
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: A constant, overwhelming presence that presses down on anyone weaker. It strips away the will to resist, making targets feel an instinctive urge to bow or submit. Even strong opponents feel their resolve weaken under its weight.

name: Holy Flame
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: A signature skill of the Serapharch: flames made from pure holy energy that burn corruption on contact. Unlike Purgatory Flames, which simply burns until released, Holy Flame actively consumes anything tied to corrupted Veyn — demons, undead, or miasma take heavy damage from it, while anything untouched by corruption barely feels it. One of the few things capable of matching Purgatory Flames head-on; the two effectively cancel each other out if they clash directly.

name: God's Index Finger
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Manifests a massive golden finger that can press down on a target to suppress their movement and power. It can also shrink into an extension of the user's own hand for close combat.

name: God Chain
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Creates strong chains of light that bind a target's body and restrict their ability to move or cast skills.

name: Holy Grail
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Manifests a sphere of pure holy fire that burns with the heat of a true sun. The user can shrink it down to the size of a pebble for extreme concentrated power, or expand it into a larger form. The bigger it becomes, the more Veyn it costs and the more the heat spreads, though the focused small form is far more destructive against a single target.

name: Warpstep
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Allows the user to instantly relocate to any point within 6 meters by folding space with Veyn.

name: Dawnveil (Serapharch)
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: The highest form of the innate angelic disguise. The user can perfectly hide their wings, halo, aura, and true nature, blending flawlessly into any society. Even strong magical senses struggle to see through it. The disguise costs almost no effort to maintain at this rank.

name: Skyward Chains
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A lesser form of God Chain. Forms lighter chains that still restrain a target but are easier to break with enough force.

name: Vanguard's Cry
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A powerful battle shout that temporarily strengthens the bodies and resolve of all angels under the user's command.

name: Aegis Ward
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Forms a solid barrier of light and condensed Veyn that can block incoming attacks. Maintaining the barrier continuously drains the user's regenerative ability.

name: Holy Mend
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A weaker version of Holy Rain. Heals allies and harms undead in a smaller area with reduced potency.

name: Angelic Aura (Aetherblade)
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A powerful but lesser version of the Serapharch's aura. It creates heavy pressure that makes weaker beings hesitate and struggle to fight at full strength. Not as absolute as the highest rank, but still difficult to ignore.

name: Swiftstep
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: The user folds space in an instant, vanishing from their current position and reappearing up to 3 meters away in a blink. The movement is nearly impossible to track with the naked eye, allowing them to slip behind an opponent, dodge a fatal strike, or close distance before the enemy can react. Though shorter in range than Warpstep, its speed and low Veyn cost make it ideal for rapid, repeated use in close combat.

name: Dawnveil (Aetherblade)
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Allows the user to hide their true form and aura, blending into normal society. The disguise is solid but not perfect — close inspection or strong magical senses can reveal subtle flaws.

name: Guiding Light
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: A gentle healing touch that closes minor wounds. It has no effect on undead or heavily corrupted beings.

name: Radiant Strike
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: Infuses the user's weapon with a faint holy charge, causing extra damage to undead and demons on contact.

name: Formation Discipline
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: When fighting near other Virtues, the user gains increased strength and defense through coordinated discipline.

name: Angelic Aura (Virtue)
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: A steady passive presence that creates unease in those nearby. It doesn't force submission, but it unsettles opponents and makes them feel watched and pressured.

name: Dawnveil (Virtue)
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: A rougher version of the disguise. It works well at a distance, but under stress or close scrutiny it becomes unstable and more likely to slip.

name: Warmth of the Realm
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: A gentle passive aura that eases minor pain, calms fear, and softens emotional distress in those nearby. It has no combat use and exists purely as a reflection of a Lumen's role as an ordinary citizen rather than a warrior.

name: Faint Ward
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: Creates a thin, fragile shield capable of blocking only a single low-power attack before shattering.

name: Angelic Aura (Lumen)
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: The weakest form. It only produces a faint sense of presence, barely noticeable unless someone is paying close attention.

name: Dawnveil (Lumen)
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: The weakest form of the angelic disguise. It can hide the user's true nature at a glance, but any close inspection or focused magical scrutiny will cause it to break almost immediately.

name: Demon Skills
subtitle: The skills of demons
description: The abilities demons wield, drawn from their corrupted Veyn and their rank. Each demon rank has its own skills, and the demon generals each carry their own personal techniques. Demon titles also grant their own set of skills, distinct from rank abilities.

name: Death Scythe
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Forms a massive scythe from pure Veyn, enchanted with an instant-death attribute. A clean cut from this weapon can end a life in a single stroke if the target is weaker or caught off guard. Its raw destructive power is the true strength of the ability.

name: Chain Reaper Scythe
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: A long chain scythe controlled entirely by the user's will. It can be compacted into a small accessory when not needed.

name: Call of the Dead
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Tears open a temporary gate that releases a group of undead soldiers to fight under the user's command.

name: Dominating Will
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Floods the surrounding area with the user's Veyn, thickening it until breathing becomes difficult and other people struggle to control their own magic. The denser the user makes it, the higher the Veyn cost.

name: Soul Oath
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Allows the user to form binding contracts with anyone. Once the contract is accepted, the other party's soul is bound until the terms are fulfilled or the user willingly releases them. Breaking the contract brings severe consequences.

name: Veyn Decomposition (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: The strongest form of the innate demon ability. Converts the user's Veyn into a dense, toxic miasma that poisons living beings, weakens holy energy, and contaminates the surrounding area.

name: Hands of Death
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: A rare high-rank ability. By touching a target, the user can erase a portion of their memories. The erasure is never complete, but it can remove key knowledge, skills, or recent events. Covering the body in stronger Veyn can briefly resist it.

name: Purgatory Flames
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Summons purple flames that cling to a target and continue burning until the user releases them or the target dies. The flames are extremely difficult to extinguish and can only be reliably blocked by a strong Holy Rain.

name: Charm
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: A skill exclusive to female demons. It forces a weaker target to obey the user's spoken commands for a limited time. Stronger beings can resist or break free more easily.

name: Soul-Sight
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Allows the user to see the flow of a target's soul, effectively predicting the direction and timing of their next attack. This ability does not work on angels of any rank.

name: Berserk (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Triggers automatically when the user's health drops critically low. Attack power and magic surge to extreme levels (roughly 20 times normal), but reasoning and self-control are sharply reduced, making the user far more reckless.

name: Demonic Aura (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: The strongest form of demonic presence. It crushes the will of those weaker than the user, creating a powerful urge to bow or submit. It can be fully cloaked by Duskveil.

name: Duskveil (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: The highest form of the innate demon disguise. The user can perfectly hide their true form and aura, passing even under close scrutiny. While active, it cuts the user's true strength roughly in half.

name: Blood Chains
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Conjures chains formed from the user's own blood and infused with Veyn. These chains can bind, drag, crush, or restrain a target. The stronger and denser the user's blood, the more powerful the chains become.

name: Warcry of Dominion
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A commanding battle shout that temporarily increases the strength and fighting spirit of all demons under the user's authority.

name: Crimson Ward
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Forms a dense barrier of hardened blood and Veyn. It can block strong attacks, but holding it steadily drains the user's ability to regenerate.

name: Blood Pact
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A lesser form of Soul Oath. It can bind a target to a specific task or promise, but the pact automatically breaks if the Bloodward who created it dies.

name: Veyn Decomposition (Bloodward)
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Converts the user's Veyn into a toxic miasma that harms living beings and interferes with holy energy. Noticeably weaker than a Mordrach's version, but still dangerous in close range.

name: Demonic Aura (Bloodward)
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A constant oppressive presence that makes those weaker feel the urge to bow or submit. It can be partially hidden with Duskveil, but not completely.

name: Berserk (Bloodward)
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Triggers at low health. Provides a strong boost to attack power and magic (around 10 times normal) while reducing clear thinking and restraint.

name: Duskveil (Bloodward)
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A strong but imperfect disguise. It hides the user's true nature well, though subtle tells may appear under close or magical inspection. While active, it reduces the user's true strength by roughly 60%.

name: Vitality Surge
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: The user deliberately burns their own life force, converting raw Vitality into a violent surge of physical power. Muscles strengthen, speed multiplies, and the body becomes capable of feats far beyond its normal limits for a short time. The greater the amount of life force sacrificed, the more overwhelming the boost — but the backlash leaves the user drained and vulnerable once the effect ends.

name: Rend Claws
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: The user’s claws are naturally honed to a lethal edge, dense enough to tear through most conventional armor, weapons, and reinforced materials. Each slash carries both physical cutting power and a faint trace of demonic energy, allowing them to rip open defenses that would stop ordinary blades.

name: Pack Tactics
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: When fighting near other Scourges, the user gains increased strength and defense through coordinated aggression.

name: Veyn Decomposition (Scourge)
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: A weaker form of the toxic miasma. It irritates and unsettles humans rather than truly poisoning them, and can cause confusion and mild disorientation.

name: Berserk (Scourge)
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: Triggers at low health. Offers a moderate boost (around 5 times normal) with reduced reasoning.

name: Demonic Aura (Scourge)
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: A weaker but still noticeable pressure. It unsettles those of lower rank and makes them more hesitant to oppose the user.

name: Duskveil (Scourge)
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: A rough disguise that works at a distance but is more likely to slip under stress or close scrutiny. While active, it reduces the user's true strength by roughly 70%.

name: Binding Contract
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: The signature ability of Gnash-rank demons. Allows them to form contracts with anyone. Once signed, both parties are bound until the terms are completed.

name: Veyn Decomposition (Gnash)
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: Produces only a thin, unsettling presence rather than true miasma. Prolonged exposure can cause mild hallucinations and disorientation in weaker targets.

name: Instinctive Bargaining
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: Gives the user a natural advantage when forming contracts or deals. The user can impose slightly more favorable terms than normal and sense when the other party is trying to cheat or hide a loophole. In combat, this manifests as the ability to force a short-term “bargain” on an opponent (e.g., “trade one attack for reduced damage” or “pause fighting for three seconds”).

name: Demonic Aura (Gnash)
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: The weakest form of demonic presence. It does not crush the will or force submission, but it creates a subtle, persistent sense of unease in those nearby — a quiet instinct that something is wrong. Most people cannot identify the source, only that they feel mildly unsettled when standing too close.

name: Duskveil (Gnash)
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: The weakest form of the disguise. It can hide the user's nature at a casual glance, but any real scrutiny will break it. While active, it reduces the user's true strength by roughly 80%.

name: Graceless Edge
subtitle: Vireth, the Fallen Grace — skill
description: A skill of Vireth, the Fallen Grace. Cuts through both holy wards and demonic wards equally, treating corrupted and uncorrupted Veyn as the same thing to sever — essentially cutting magic if you have enough Veyn to cut it. Where most weapons are either blessed or unholy and struggle against the opposite type, Vireth doesn't distinguish between the two at all.

name: Split Grace
subtitle: Vireth, the Fallen Grace — skill
description: A skill of Vireth, the Fallen Grace. Channels both a holy (angelic) and a corrupted (demonic) aura through the blade at the same time, striking with both auras layered into one attack. For most wielders this is dangerous to hold even briefly, since angelic and demonic energy naturally resist coexisting in the same space, let alone the same blade. As a result it causes a force-splitting explosion of the cut area.

name: Pallantine
subtitle: Light-half elves of the Arubian Forest — branches from Elves
description: A branch of the Elves race. Pallantine are the light-half elves who inhabit the Arubian Forest, the light half of the Ether Forest within the Human Realm. They split from the main Elves race and took the light side of the forest as their territory. They are friendly to humans and trade with travelers, and they use Griffens as transport from the highest mountain parts. Their blood is one of the ingredients required to craft a Veilstone Amulet. They stay in the Arubian Forest, the light half of the Ether Forest. They are used as transport by the Griffen, who live on the highest parts of the mountains.

name: Veilborn
subtitle: Dark-half elves of the Umbrage Forest — branches from Elves
description: A branch of the Elves race. Veilborn are the dark-half elves who inhabit the Umbrage Forest, the dark half of the Ether Forest within the Demon Realm. They split from the main Elves race and took the dark side of the forest as their territory. They are hostile to outsiders and trust only themselves. Their blood is one of the ingredients required to craft an Agro Totem. They stay in the Umbrage Forest, the dark half of the Ether Forest, and they only trust themselves. Their blood is one of the ingredients required to craft an Agro Totem.

The Academy also trains those who show exceptional affinity, offering advanced instruction in their chosen class. The Academy Altar, located within the Academy grounds, is a more powerful version of the Common Altar and provides clearer readings of class affinity and starting grade.

Sofia also gave him the Auralis Ruby from his mother which would seal his true appearance, he can release the seal though for a limited time

name: Ruby Divina’s Plot
subtitle: The mortal ruler’s gambit
description: Ruby Divina is the only mortal ruler in a world governed by immortals, and she has spent her entire reign making humanity too useful — and too dangerous — to be worth crushing. She has known about Jaiden Marlock from the beginning: the hybrid hiding in her realm under a maid’s care is no secret to her, and she has shielded him not from kindness but because he is her insurance, the one being both realms would go to war over. As Jaiden grows into his strength, she is forced to choose what she has spent her life avoiding — keep sheltering the boy who could make humanity a power, or hand him to whichever realm offers the better terms. Her choice, when it comes, decides whether humanity survives free or becomes a vassal, and whether Ruby Divina is remembered as the ruler who saved her people or the one who sold the world’s last hope.

name: Clint Ashborn’s Plot
subtitle: The immaculate tyrant
description: Clint Ashborn has ruled the Angel Realm so long the realm has forgotten there was ever another way. He ordered his own right-hand man, Ordium, executed for loving a demon and fathering the hybrid child, and he calls it mercy — the one clean cut that kept chaos from the door. He believes the Veyn Vow and the hierarchy are the only things standing between order and the collapse of everything. But every impossible thing Jaiden Marlock is, is a refutation of Clint’s entire life, and as the hybrid grows, Clint is set on a collision course with the child he tried to prevent — an enemy he cannot dismiss, because he is not wrong that the hybrid threatens the world’s balance, only wrong about what to do with it.

name: Wener Leger’s Plot
subtitle: The patient tyrant
description: Wener Leger was cast out of the Angel Realm, and Dark Moon is the blade he built from the wreckage of that fall. Its goal is domination of the Realms, with Wener at the top, and he is patient enough to hide behind a swordsmanship teacher’s post at Elyndor Academy while he pieces the world’s next tyrant together from its own cast-offs — the fallen, the banished, the disgraced, and Licent Varak’s raw ambition. He is watching Jaiden Marlock, the first hybrid, the way a collector watches a rare weapon he has not yet decided how to wield. There is no higher cause and no hidden mercy in Wener; he does not want to save the world from its lies. He wants to own it.

name: Tera Morage’s Plot
subtitle: The tyrant whose one mercy was a death sentence
description: Tera Morage did not inherit the Mordrach’s crown — she tore it from the king before her, the way every Fiend who ever ruled the Demon Realm rose by killing the one above, and she has never once relaxed her grip since. Unkillable by anything short of a Divine Weapon, she let that invulnerability curdle into contempt, ruling her generals and her right-hand men with the certainty that nothing in the realm can touch her. The single exception was Lisa. Lisa was not merely her right-hand — she was her friend, the one demon Tera trusted enough to keep close — and so when Licent Varak brought her the truth of Lisa’s affair with an angel, Tera did what no Mordrach is supposed to do: she showed mercy. She demoted Lisa to Gnash, a punishment meant to hurt but not to kill, because in a realm where strength is the only truth, that was the softest sentence she could pass without appearing weak. It was still a death sentence. Licent, who had only ever hated Lisa, had her killed by his own men — and Tera, who can be killed by nothing in her realm, learned that the one law she cannot bend is the one that put her on the throne: when a Mordrach dies, all the Veyn she holds passes to the heir who can withstand it. Her court is a circle of knives, every one of them waiting for a Divine Weapon to appear, and Licent Varak, her own second right-hand, is already in the dark with Dark Moon. She does not see it, because she has spent so long fearing nothing that she has forgotten how to fear her own shadow.

name: Wener Leger
subtitle: Leader of Dark Moon
description: Wener Leger was cast out of the Angel Realm, and Dark Moon is what he built from the wreckage of that fall — not a refuge, but a blade pointed back at everything that discarded him. Its goal is exactly what it sounds like: domination of the Realms, with Wener at the top, and he is patient enough to hide behind a swordsmanship teacher’s post at Elyndor Academy while he pieces the world’s next tyrant together from its own cast-offs. He recruits the desperate and the disgraced — fallen angels, banished demons, and now Licent Varak’s raw ambition — not to free them, but to use them, because the broken are the cheapest soldiers and the easiest to convince they are owed something. He is watching Jaiden Marlock, the first hybrid, the way a collector watches a rare weapon he has not yet decided how to wield. There is no higher cause beneath Dark Moon’s banner and no hidden mercy in its leader; Wener does not want to save the world from its lies. He wants to own it, and he has spent his long exile learning exactly how.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Laren Vornath

name: Demon of melancholy
subtitle: The title of Sythra Kaelis
description: A title borne by Sythra Kaelis — the general whose cruelty wears the face of mercy, draining sadness and will alike.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Sythra Kaelis

name: Demon of gluttony
subtitle: The title of Nyra Thessan
description: A title borne by Nyra Thessan — the general who devours magic and is never filled.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Nyra Thessan

name: Demon of love
subtitle: The title of Isella Marrek
description: A title borne by Isella Marrek — the general who has never loved anyone back, only collected the love of others.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Isella Marrek

name: Second Pillar, Helious
subtitle: Helios, the all-seeing sun
description: The Second Pillar of the Six Pillars of Angels — borne by Cyrion, referencing Helios, the all-seeing sun.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Cyrion

name: Third Pillar, Areous
subtitle: Ares, god of war
description: The Third Pillar of the Six Pillars of Angels — borne by Serathiel, referencing Ares, god of war.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Serathiel

name: Fourth Pillar, Deimous
subtitle: Deimos, dread personified
description: The Fourth Pillar of the Six Pillars of Angels — borne by Liora Veyne, referencing Deimos, dread personified.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Liora Veyne

name: Fifth Pillar, Horkous
subtitle: Horkos, god of oaths
description: The Fifth Pillar of the Six Pillars of Angels — borne by Thalor Elwin, referencing Horkos, god of oaths.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Thalor Elwin

name: Sixth Pillar, Argous
subtitle: Argus, the hundred-eyed watcher
description: The Sixth Pillar of the Six Pillars of Angels — borne by Aranweis, referencing Argus, the hundred-eyed watcher.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Aranweis

name: Demon of the Bloodhound
subtitle: The title of Licent Varak
description: The title of Licent Varak — he hunts a scent to its end and never lets it go, tracking the one thread that undid a life.

fields.label: Held by
fields.value: Licent Varak

name: Red Whisper
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A quiet, Veyn-laced whisper that can interrupt and shatter an enemy's spell while it is being cast.

name: Blood Jape
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Creates a moving double formed from blood and Veyn. The double can take a fatal hit in the user's place before collapsing.

name: Traitor’s Step
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: After wounding an enemy, the user can instantly exchange positions with them. In the blink of an eye, the injured target is left standing where the user just was, while the user appears in the enemy’s former place — often behind them or in a far more advantageous position. The sudden swap creates perfect openings for follow-up attacks.

name: Grey Miasma
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Releases a thin grey mist that clings to the area and slows the movements of anyone who breathes it in.

name: Widow’s Toll
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Releases a single deep, resonant note that echoes in the bones of those who hear it. The sound forces the affected to begin crying and strips away their will to fight, making them more obedient to the user for a short time.

name: Fading Wound
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Wounds inflicted by the user do not only cause pain — they steadily drain the target's Veyn over time.

name: Heart-Bind
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Creates a Veyn-based bond with a target that prevents them from killing the user. Any damage dealt to the user is partially transferred back onto the one who is bound.

name: Lover’s Step
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Subtly influences a target's emotions, making them more willing to listen, trust, or obey the user for a limited time.

name: Bond-Sight
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Allows the user to see the emotional and magical bonds connecting people. Strong bonds appear as clear threads of light or darkness. The user can read the nature of the bond (loyalty, love, hatred, contract, etc.) and, with enough focus, temporarily weaken or disrupt a bond, creating hesitation or conflict in the target.

name: Siphon
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Drains magical energy from targets weaker than the user and adds a portion of it to the user's own reserves.

name: Unslaked
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: The more magical energy the user absorbs, the stronger their body and attacks temporarily become.

name: Seal
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Temporarily locks away one of an opponent's special abilities, preventing its use for a short period.

name: Lapse
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Slows the flow of time around a single target, making their movements and reactions noticeably sluggish for a short period.

name: Rewind
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Reverses the last few seconds of damage the user has taken, restoring the body to its previous state.

name: Still Hour
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Freezes a target in the brief moment between one breath and the next, locking them in place for a short time.

name: Long Sight
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Extends the user's vision across great distances within the realm, allowing them to spot threats long before they arrive.

name: Burning Path
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Leaves a glowing trail of light on the ground that scorches and damages anyone who steps across it.

name: Second Sun
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Creates a hovering sphere of intense light that blinds a target and marks them, making them easier to track and hit.

name: Battle Trance
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Pushes the user into a focused state where pain no longer interferes with movement or decision-making.

name: Ravager’s Grasp
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Violently tears a weapon or shield from an opponent's hands using raw force mixed with Veyn.

name: War-Worn
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: With every wound the user receives, their body becomes harder and more resistant to further damage.

name: Dread-Herald
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: The user speaks a single word of power that plants a deep, growing fear inside the target. The fear intensifies over time, steadily weakening the target’s will, slowing their movements, and making it harder for them to use skills. If the fear is allowed to fully mature, the target becomes temporarily paralyzed by terror or forced to flee. Stronger targets take longer to break, but the effect is harder to shake once it takes root.

name: Unheralded
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: The user vanishes from sight and reappears instantly in a location where the target least expects them. The sudden appearance carries a brief disruptive force that staggers the opponent and leaves them open for a follow-up attack. The skill can be used in rapid succession, but each use after the first becomes harder to control and costs more Veyn.

name: Dreadweight
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Unleashes a crushing wave of pure dread that forces the target downward under its weight. The pressure slows their movements, weakens their stance, and makes it difficult for them to stay upright or use skills effectively. Stronger targets can resist being fully forced to their knees, but the oppressive weight still hampers them significantly.

name: Altar-Rite
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Channels residual power similar to the Sundering Altar. The user can force a temporary magical binding on a target, locking them into a short-term condition or restriction (e.g., “cannot lie,” “cannot attack,” “cannot flee”) for a limited time. Stronger targets resist longer.

name: Vowbrand
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Places a conditional curse on a target. If the target breaks a stated rule or promise, the curse activates — draining Veyn, weakening the body, or briefly locking their movements.

name: Truthvein
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Allows the user to sense the truth behind spoken words. Lies, half-truths, and deceptions become clear. In combat, it also helps the user read feints and false openings.

name: All-Seeing Eye
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Grants the user complete awareness of everything happening within their designated area of watch at the same time.

name: Warden’s Recall
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Grants the user a perfect, unbreakable memory of everything they have ever personally witnessed. Every face, every conversation, every detail of a battlefield, every shift in expression is preserved with absolute clarity and can be recalled at will, no matter how much time has passed. This allows the user to notice patterns others miss, recognize people they saw only once years ago, and reconstruct events with flawless accuracy.

name: Warden’s Mark
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Places an invisible mark on a target that allows the user to track them anywhere within the realm.

name: Glut
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Forces far more Veyn into a target's body than it can safely contain, causing internal damage and disruption.

name: Cornucopia
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Releases a wide burst of surplus Veyn in all directions, overwhelming and damaging weaker beings caught in the wave.

name: Reap
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: The user extends their power across the surrounding area and violently pulls Veyn from every weaker being within range. Streams of stolen energy are torn away from their targets and drawn directly into the user, simultaneously weakening everyone affected while rapidly restoring and amplifying the user’s own reserves.

name: Sovereign Aura
subtitle: Mastered skill
description: A refined and intensified form of Demonic Aura strong enough to force even other Bloodwards to feel heavy pressure and the urge to submit.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mastered

name: Auralis Seal
subtitle: Personalized skill
description: Temporarily seals a target’s active abilities and aura, cutting them off from their power. While sealed, the target cannot use skills or project their aura and is forced to fight with only their physical strength and basic techniques. The duration depends on how much Veyn the user has available, and the consumption is extremely high, making it difficult to maintain for long.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Personalized

name: Time’s Grasp
subtitle: Mastered skill
description: Temporarily halts a single target's personal flow of time for a few heartbeats, freezing them in place.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mastered

name: The Stolen Hour
subtitle: Personalized skill
description: Locks a target into a short time loop of their most recent actions (usually the last 3–5 seconds). While trapped, the target is forced to endlessly re-live that same moment and cannot act outside of it. The user remains free to move, attack, or reposition during the loop. Maintaining the ability drains Veyn continuously, and stronger targets can eventually force their way out.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Personalized

name: Blood-Oath
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A contract sealed in the breaker’s own blood. Deadlier than a Blood Pact — it does not break when he dies, and whoever breaks it forfeits their Veyn to him.

name: Disinter
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Forces hidden or suppressed information to the surface. The user can drag out a target’s recent memories, sealed abilities, or buried emotions, temporarily exposing weaknesses, past injuries, or sealed powers. In combat, this can reveal openings or force a target’s hidden form/ability to surface against their will.

name: Guile
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A carefully spoken lie that sinks into the target's mind and feels as if it has always been true.

name: Titles and Their Skills
subtitle: Every title carries its own skills
description: A title is more than a name — each one carries its own set of skills, mastered by the one who holds it. A title’s skills are distinct from a character’s innate rank abilities. Titles cannot be passed down; only a ruler of the first rank can grant a title to another, and only if they see that person as worthy of it. What can be passed down is a personalized skill — like Ordium’s The Stolen Hour or Lisa’s Auralis Seal — which flows from parent to offspring.

name: The Six Pillars of Angels
subtitle: The six generals of the Angel Realm
description: The Angel Realm’s six generals are known as the Six Pillars, ranked First through Sixth. The First Pillar is Chronous, held by Ordium; the Second through Sixth are Helious, Areous, Deimous, Horkous, and Argous. Each pillar bears a title, its own skills, and a duty — from guarding the Sundering Altar to standing as the Serapharch’s personal guard.

name: Cherubim
subtitle: The throne-guardians — the apex angels
description: The highest type of angel, the guardians of the throne. The Serapharch — the ruler of the Angel Realm — is of this type. They are essentially immortal and can only be killed by a Divine Weapon or a Corrupted Divine Weapon (Vireth, the Fallen Grace).

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Imperishable

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Luminous, pale gold like sunlight through marble, holding light rather than reflecting it, faintly radiant at the edges.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Tall and statuesque, carrying themselves like living monuments, regal, unhurried, impossible to rush.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Pure radiant gold with no visible pupil, glowing steady and calm with the same light as their halo.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: Their Angelic Aura is so pure it visibly brightens the air around them, a quiet, overwhelming weight that makes lesser beings lower their gaze.

name: Malakhim
subtitle: The messenger host — the common true angels
description: The common type of true angel, the faithful host who take the Veyn Vow. The Aetherblade Lord Angels, Virtues, and Lumen all belong to this type.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Veyn-Regen

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Fair, luminous, holding a soft white-gold glow, less radiant than a Cherubim's deep gold luminance, but still clearly not human.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Upright and disciplined, built for duty and combat readiness rather than a Cherubim's towering presence.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Bright, pale gold or white, glowing steadily, matching the brightness of their halo.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: Their Angelic Aura is clearly visible, a genuine glow and pressure in the air around them, though not as overwhelming as a Cherubim's.

name: Fallen Angels
subtitle: The broken — cast out for breaking the vow
description: The type of angel who broke the Veyn Vow and was cast out of the Angel Realm. They keep their wings and power but can never take another vow, leaving their connection to Veyn unstable and unregulated.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Rapid-Mend

name: Imperishable
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Cannot be struck down by ordinary means — only a Divine Weapon or a Corrupted Divine Weapon can end them.

name: Veyn-Regen
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Their Veyn replenishes on its own, faster than it drains.

name: Rapid-Mend
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Their regeneration speeds up in bursts, mending wounds quicker than it should.

name: Fiends
subtitle: The apex demons
description: The highest type of demon, the rulers of the Demon Realm. The Mordrach are of this type — they cannot be killed by regular or holy weapons, only by a Divine Weapon.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Sovereign Resilience

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Deep onyx-black, almost absorbing light, with faint ember-orange cracks like cooling magma at the edges of their horns and fingers.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Towering, broad, heavy, they carry themselves like living thrones.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Smoldering embers, no visible pupil, shedding a faint heat-haze.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: Their Demonic Aura is so thick it visibly darkens the air around them.

name: Dregs
subtitle: The common demons
description: The common type of demon, the rank-and-file of the Demon Realm. The Bloodward, Scourge, and Gnash all belong to this type.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Vitality-Regen

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Rough, ashen or bruised-purple, scarred and battle-worn.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Varied but hardened, soldier-like, lean and coiled.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Bloodshot amber or sickly yellow, no warmth.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: A faint, constant oppressive hum, lesser than a Fiend's, but always felt.

name: Imps
subtitle: The impish demons
description: A demon type set apart from the ordinary Dregs — the impish few, including Lisa and Laren Vornath the Jester demon, and the MC’s demon half.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Veyn-Touch

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Warmer and less monstrous than a Dreg's, closer to a deep violet or plum tone rather than ash or bruise-purple, unsettling mostly in how normal it can look at a glance.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Lithe and human-passing, more agile than hardened, built for misdirection rather than raw force.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Sharp, alert, with a flicker of amusement even in danger, unlike a Dreg's flat hostility.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: Their aura doesn't press down the way a Fiend's or Dreg's does, it unsettles more subtly, a playful-cruel undertone that makes people uneasy without knowing exactly why.

name: Sovereign Resilience
subtitle: Innate ability
description:
Cannot be harmed or killed by regular weapons — only a Divine Weapon can end them.
They can be damaged by a holy weapon

name: Vitality-Regen
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Their regeneration runs on Veyn or Vitality, replenishing faster than it drains.

name: Veyn-Touch
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Can drain the Veyn of others without them knowing or feeling it — only a slight discomfort.

name: Angel Evolution
subtitle: How a new Serapharch is made
description: To become the first rank — the Serapharch — the heir is flooded with a massive amount of Veyn, then exposed to ten days of raw, concentrated Veyn. If they survive, they evolve into a Cherubim angel and become the new ruler of the Angel Realm. This rite is performed on the heir, and only after the king has died or has given up the throne.

name: Demon Evolution
subtitle: How a new Mordrach is made
description: To evolve from a Dregs demon to a Fiend — the Mordrach — the first rank must die. When that happens, all the Veyn the first rank held while alive is passed on to the next heir; if the heir can withstand it, they become the new king of the Demon Realm.

name: Race Types
subtitle: Species, separate from rank
description: Beyond their rank, every angel and demon belongs to a race type — a kind of being, not a position. The angels have three types: the Cherubim (the throne-guardian apex), the Malakhim (the common true angels), and the Fallen Angels (the vow-breakers). The demons have three: the Fiends (the apex), the Dregs (the common demons), and the Imps (the impish few set apart from the ordinary line). Race type and rank are independent — a Serapharch and a Lumen are both angels, but at different ranks of the same kind.

name: Innate Abilities
subtitle: One per race type
description: Each race type carries one innate ability, shared by every member of that type regardless of rank. These are distinct from learned skills: they are born into the blood, not trained. The Cherubim are Imperishable, the Malakhim carry Veyn-Regen, and the Fallen Angels carry Rapid-Mend; the Fiends are Sovereign Resilience, the Dregs carry Vitality-Regen, and the Imps carry Veyn-Touch.

name: Mastered and Personalized Skills
subtitle: The two highest tiers of skill
description: Beyond ordinary skills, a character can reach two higher tiers. A Mastered skill is one they have perfected beyond what their rank normally allows — their peak. A Personalized skill is their signature, unique to them alone, forged from their own experience. These are the skills that can be passed down to an offspring, and they mark the few who stand above their rank.

name: The Hybrid
subtitle: Angel and demon in one body
description: A hybrid is an angel and a demon born of a single body — a union the world considers impossible, since Veyn and Ren cannot coexist and the two realms’ natures are opposed. Jaiden Marlock is the first, born of Ordium (an Aetherblade Lord Angel) and Lisa (a Bloodward), and his aura carries both an angelic and a demonic aura at once. Hybrids inherit both parents’ race types — in Jaiden’s case the Imp demon half and the Malakhim angel half — and can draw on the abilities of both. Because such a being has never existed before, there are no rules for it, only what Jaiden himself becomes.

name: Spirits
subtitle: Not demons — something else
description: Not every creature of the Dark belongs to the Demon Realm’s ranks. Some are spirits — beings given shape by unstable Veyn rather than born of the demonic bloodline. The Cindergrave Wraith Lord and the Lesser Cindergrave Wraiths are evil spirits: fragments of will pulled from the fallen kingdom of Lethmoor and held together by the unstable Veyn of its terrain. They are not demons and hold no demon rank; they simply endure where the Veyn is too broken to be called a realm, feeding on the Veyn of the living to stay whole.

name: Aelthar
subtitle: The extinct realm-makers
description: An extinct race, wiped out by the former ruler of the Human Realm, forcing the survivors to flee by tearing open the Hidden Realm as a hiding place — an act so violent it nearly destroyed the world outright. Escaping the ruler didn’t save them: once inside, the realm’s own creatures began forming almost immediately, and the Aelthar had no way to survive against them. Nearly the entire race died out inside the very refuge they built, save for one survivor — the Headmaster of the Academy — who alone learned to endure it and later became the only person to ever successfully brew the Ethereal Potion.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Pale, ash-grey skin; flat, dark eyes that do not reflect light; faint markings that glow faintly with Veyn beneath the skin.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Potent Blood

fields.label: Curse
fields.value: Cursed by the world core for tearing open the Hidden Realm — every Aelthar bore the rune collar.

name: Potent Blood
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Their blood has an extremely high, potent healing capability, and is an excellent conduit for magic — allowing them to use powerful magic easily.

name: The Aelthar
subtitle: The extinct race of the Hidden Realm
description: The Aelthar were an ancient race of realm-makers, wiped out by the former ruler of the Human Realm. Their survivors tore open the Hidden Realm as a hiding place, an act so violent it nearly destroyed the world, but even that refuge could not save them — the realm’s creatures formed almost immediately and the Aelthar died out inside it, leaving one survivor: the Headmaster of the Academy, who alone learned to endure the realm and became the only person to ever brew the Ethereal Potion.

name: The World Barrier
subtitle: Its magical origins
description: The world barrier was raised to split the realms apart after the old race’s tearing-open of the Hidden Realm nearly destroyed the world. Its magic is drawn directly from the untouched world core — the same primal source from which Veyn is pulled — rather than from any single caster, which is why it has endured without ever being re-made. The Shudon, stone golems carved from the world core, were set at the entrances to the three main realms — Human, Angel, and Demon — to guard the barrier and keep the world from collapsing inward. The Hidden Realm has no Shudon; its only entrance is the wandering portal.

name: The World Core
subtitle: The untouched heart of the world
description: The world core has no mind and no body — only a will. It is the untouched source from which all Veyn flows into the world, but it does not think or feel the way a living thing does. When the world was put in danger — when the old race tore open the Hidden Realm and nearly destroyed everything — the core’s will answered on its own, raising the world barrier to split the realms apart and carving the Shudon from its own stone to guard the three main realms’ entrances against collapse.

name: Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn
subtitle: The two opposing poles of Veyn
description: Holy energy and corrupted Veyn are the two opposite poles of Veyn — one purified into gold, the other darkened into black. They are naturally at war with each other: holy energy burns corruption on contact, while corrupted Veyn contaminates and corrodes holy auras and holy energy. When they clash directly, they cancel each other out — Holy Flame and Purgatory Flames each consume the other rather than one overcoming the other.

name: The Three Forms of Veyn
subtitle: Humans, angels, and demons
description: The three peoples of the world each draw on a different form of Veyn. Humans use raw Veyn — neutral and silver-blue, the unshaped source itself. Angels channel Holy Energy — Veyn purified into gold. Demons wield Corrupted Veyn — Veyn darkened into miasma. All three trace back to the same world core; they are not separate powers, but one Veyn expressed three ways, each reflecting the nature of those who use it.

name: The Formation of Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn
subtitle: How raw Veyn becomes gold or black
description: Both holy energy and corrupted Veyn are made from the same raw Veyn, but by opposite processes. Holy energy is formed through purification: a holy being burns away Veyn’s impurity — an angel through the discipline of their halo and Veyn Vow, a saint or diviner through their own holy channeling — brightening the Veyn from silver-blue into gold. Corrupted Veyn is formed through corruption: a demon turns its own Veyn inward and decomposes it into miasma, darkening and poisoning it until it stains a deep purple or black. One Veyn pulled in two directions — which is exactly why they cannot coexist and cancel each other out when they meet.

name: Sigils
subtitle: The currency of the three realms
description: The single currency used across all three realms, minted in three metals. One hundred silver sigils make one gold sigil, and one thousand gold sigils make one platinum sigil — so a single platinum sigil is worth one hundred thousand silver. The same coins circulate in the Human, Angel, and Demon Realms alike.

fields.label: Exchange
fields.value: 100 silver = 1 gold; 1,000 gold = 1 platinum

fields.label: Tiers
fields.value: Silver (lowest), Gold (middle), Platinum (highest)

name: Silver Sigil
subtitle: The lowest coin
description: The lowest tier of currency, used for everyday purchases. One hundred silver sigils are worth one gold sigil.

fields.label: Value
fields.value: 1 silver = 1/100 gold

fields.label: Tier
fields.value: Lowest

name: Gold Sigil
subtitle: The middle coin
description: The middle tier of currency. One gold sigil is worth one hundred silver, and one thousand gold sigils are worth one platinum sigil.

fields.label: Value
fields.value: 1 gold = 100 silver; 1,000 gold = 1 platinum

fields.label: Tier
fields.value: Middle

name: Platinum Sigil
subtitle: The highest coin
description: The highest tier of currency, reserved for large transactions and wealth. One platinum sigil is worth one thousand gold, or one hundred thousand silver.

fields.label: Value
fields.value: 1 platinum = 1,000 gold = 100,000 silver

fields.label: Tier
fields.value: Highest

name: Aldermere
subtitle: The kingdom of the Human Realm
description: The ruling kingdom of the Human Realm, seat of Ruby Divina. Unlike the other realms’ capitals, Aldermere governs no rigid caste or rank — its people are the varied hundreds of thousands of humanity, and its ruler holds power through political skill and the trust of that population rather than divine right or raw strength.

fields.label: Ruler
fields.value: Ruby Divina

name: Aurelion
subtitle: The kingdom of the Angel Realm
description: The ruling kingdom of the Angel Realm, seat of the Serapharch Clint Ashborn. Built around the throne, it is home to the angelic hierarchy at its purest — the Six Pillars, the Veyn Vow, and the ranks held in order. Its population numbers only in the tens of thousands, small enough to be governed perfectly.

fields.label: Ruler
fields.value: Clint Ashborn

name: Vorath
subtitle: The kingdom of the Demon Realm
description: The ruling kingdom of the Demon Realm, seat of the Mordrach Tera Morage. A city that never sleeps, its hundreds of thousands churning as demons kill their way up the ranks and breed to fill what battle empties. It is the only realm capital that fields endless armies.

fields.label: Ruler
fields.value: Tera Morage

name: Hybrid Fusion
subtitle: The mutated skills of the True Hybrid Form
description: When Jaiden Marlock enters his True Hybrid Form, the skills of his two bloodlines stop being separate sets. Each skill of the Aetherblade Lord Angel rank and each skill of the Bloodward demon rank mutate and fuse together, one with another, becoming a single hybrid skill that neither race could wield alone. The fused skills draw on Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn at once, and exist only while the hybrid form is held.

name: Hybrid Skills
subtitle: The fused skills of the hybrid
description: The mutated skills of Jaiden Marlock’s True Hybrid Form. When he enters it, each of his Aetherblade Lord Angel rank skills fuses with a Bloodward demon rank skill, becoming a single hybrid skill that neither race could wield alone. They draw on Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn at once.

name: Twilight Chains
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: Conjures thick chains woven from hardened holy light and living blood. The chains bind with far greater strength than either Skyward Chains or Blood Chains alone. Wherever they touch, they burn with holy fire while simultaneously drinking the target’s strength and Veyn. The more the victim struggles, the tighter and hungrier the chains become, rapidly exhausting even strong opponents.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Skyward Chains + Blood Chains

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Cry of the Sundered
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: A single, dual-natured battle cry that carries both angelic authority and demonic dominance. Allies who hear it feel their strength, speed, and resolve surge, while enemies experience a sudden collapse of will — their bodies hesitating and their skills faltering for a critical moment. The effect is strong enough to turn the momentum of a battle in a single breath.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Vanguard's Cry + Warcry of Dominion

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Hollow Aegis
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: Forms a layered barrier of solidified light and hardened blood. The ward is significantly tougher than either Aegis Ward or Crimson Ward alone. Instead of only draining the user’s regeneration, it absorbs a portion of the force from incoming attacks and converts it into restorative energy, partially healing the user with every blow it blocks.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Aegis Ward + Crimson Ward

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Mend-and-Rot
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: A dual-natured touch that heals and corrupts at the same time. Allies struck by it are rapidly healed by pure holy light, while enemies suffer rotting, decomposing Veyn that eats through flesh and magic. The energy taken from the corrupted side is recycled to fuel the healing, allowing the user to restore allies without fully draining their own reserves.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Holy Mend + Veyn Decomposition (Bloodward)

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Aura of the Split Crown
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: The complete fusion of an Aetherblade’s Angelic Aura and a Bloodward’s Demonic Aura. Those weaker than the user are crushed by two opposing forces at once — the overwhelming urge to kneel in submission and the primal instinct to flee in terror. The conflicting pressure shatters focus, slows reactions, and makes sustained resistance extremely difficult.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Angelic Aura (Aetherblade) + Demonic Aura (Bloodward)

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Frenzied Step
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: A rage-fueled blink that combines Swiftstep with the Bloodward’s Berserk state. The user vanishes and reappears behind a target in an instant, each use feeding their growing frenzy. With every step, their strength multiplies and their movements become faster and harder to track, until they are little more than a blur of overwhelming force.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Swiftstep + Berserk (Bloodward)

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Gloaming Veil
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: The perfect fusion of Dawnveil and Duskveil. The user can completely erase all traces of their hybrid nature, both auras, wings, horns, and halo. Even under close magical scrutiny, the disguise holds firm, making them appear as an ordinary human or whichever form they choose to present. Maintaining it still carries a cost, but far less than using either veil separately.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Dawnveil (Aetherblade) + Duskveil (Bloodward)

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: The World Curse
subtitle: A curse given by the world core
description: Forms a rune collar around the person’s neck. The bearer is unavoidably hunted by the Shudon when spotted and will be killed. The curse was first laid by the world core upon the Aelthar, as punishment for tearing open the Hidden Realm and nearly destroying the world — a mark the will of the world placed on an entire race for the crime of nearly unmaking it.

fields.label: Brand
fields.value: Makes a rune-like design around the person’s neck and can awaken the golems to hunt the person down. With this mark on, teleportation out of the realm or place is blocked and rendered unusable.

fields.label: Ban
fields.value: Blocks any use of teleportation out of the realm, and the bearer is hunted down and killed by the Shudon. This means you are locked down and stuck in the realm you were in when you got it.

fields.label: Mark
fields.value: This mark can’t be hidden or removed by any means.

fields.label: Origin
fields.value: First laid on the Aelthar by the world core, for tearing open the Hidden Realm.

name: Piercing Lance
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Fires a concentrated spear of raw Veyn that explodes on impact. At its most basic, the lance is little more than a sharp bolt of silver-blue energy — fast, damaging, but easily blocked by even a basic Veyn barrier. The caster can release it quickly for lower damage or charge it longer for a stronger blast. Main mid-range attack for any practicing Mage. The lance leaves a faint trail of dissolved air in its wake, and the explosion on impact sends shards of residual Veyn scattering in a small radius.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 1st Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Basic offensive spell — the first spell any Mage learns. A concentrated spear of raw Veyn that explodes on impact.

name: Glass Bastion
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Creates a translucent wall of condensed Veyn that blocks physical and magical attacks. At its most basic, the wall is thin and brittle — it can stop a sword swing or a low-level spell, but sustained fire or a heavy blow will shatter it. Strength and duration depend entirely on how much Veyn the caster pours into it. The wall shimmers with a faint silver-blue light, and cracks appear along its surface as it absorbs damage. Once it breaks, the Veyn dissipates into nothing.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 1st Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
