fields.label: Gravekeeper
fields.value: Controls multiple undead, drains Veyn from corpses, basic necrotic pulses

fields.label: Bonewarden
fields.value: Binds spirits to remains for smarter undead, creates bone projectiles

fields.label: Deathcaller
fields.value: Reanimates large groups, creates undead legions, enhanced necrotic attacks

fields.label: Necromancer
fields.value: Powerful undead that retain former abilities, large-scale simultaneous control

fields.label: Grave Lord
fields.value: Permanent undead army, harvests souls for later use, commands elite undead

fields.label: Death Sovereign
fields.value: Controls multiple powerful undead simultaneously, maintains permanent undead guard, harvests residual essence

name: Bladesinger — Blade Harmony Stages
subtitle: Bladesinger progression system
description: Bladesingers advance through stages of blade-Ren harmony — how perfectly their body, blade, and Ren flow as one. The stages are: Novice Blade → Swift Blade → Crimson Blade → Storm Blade → Phantom Blade → Eternal Blade → Perfect Edge. At Novice Blade, they perform basic sword strikes. At Perfect Edge, every movement is optimal, every defense flawless, and the blade becomes an extension of their soul.

fields.label: Stages
fields.value: Novice Blade → Swift Blade → Crimson Blade → Storm Blade → Phantom Blade → Eternal Blade → Perfect Edge

fields.label: Novice Blade
fields.value: Basic sword strikes, simple Ren coating on blade, rapid sweeping attacks

fields.label: Swift Blade
fields.value: Enhanced speed and blade dance, Ren edge cuts through harder materials

fields.label: Crimson Blade
fields.value: Powerful counter-strikes, wind step for instant closing, ghost cut from unexpected angles

fields.label: Storm Blade
fields.value: Tempest slash whirlwinds, passive grace enhances balance and reaction

fields.label: Phantom Blade
fields.value: Bladesong state enhances all physical abilities, near-invisible blade movements

fields.label: Eternal Blade
fields.value: Becomes one with the blade, executes techniques with perfect precision

fields.label: Perfect Edge
fields.value: Every movement optimal, zero wasted motion, blade is extension of soul

name: Berserker — Rage Ascension
subtitle: Berserker progression system
description: Berserkers advance through stages of rage mastery — how deeply they can tap into their Ren-fueled fury without losing themselves. The stages are: Rageborn → Bloodrager → Wrathbringer → Battlegraced → Berserk → Warlord → Avatar of War. At Rageborn, they enter controlled rage for strength boosts. At Avatar of War, their roar distorts the air, shatters structures, and empowers allies while crushing enemy morale.

fields.label: Stages
fields.value: Rageborn → Bloodrager → Wrathbringer → Battlegraced → Berserk → Warlord → Avatar of War

fields.label: Rageborn
fields.value: Controlled rage increases strength and pain tolerance, basic war howl

fields.label: Bloodrager
fields.value: Stronger rage surges, devastating single attacks, Ren burst for area damage

fields.label: Wrathbringer
fields.value: Fights through wounds that would stop others, powerful crippling blows

fields.label: Battlegraced
fields.value: Full berserk mode increases strength and speed dramatically, rage burst knocks back enemies

fields.label: Berserk
fields.value: Massive power increase, all rage abilities enhanced, fights past death's threshold

fields.label: Warlord
fields.value: Roar empowers allies and crushes enemy morale, war cry staggers entire armies

fields.label: Avatar of War
fields.value: Final rage burst on death deals catastrophic damage, all abilities at absolute peak

name: Sentinel — Guardian Oath Ranks
subtitle: Sentinel progression system
description: Sentinels advance through ranks based on their protective ability and endurance. The ranks are: Guard → Shield Bearer → Warden → Bulwark Knight → Citadel → Immortal Guardian → Eternal Sentinel. At Guard, they reinforce armor with Ren. At Eternal Sentinel, they become a wide-area defensive bastion, taking drastically reduced damage and protecting a large zone around them.

fields.label: Ranks
fields.value: Guard → Shield Bearer → Warden → Bulwark Knight → Citadel → Immortal Guardian → Eternal Sentinel

fields.label: Guard
fields.value: Reinforces armor with Ren, creates basic Ren walls, taunts enemies

fields.label: Shield Bearer
fields.value: Fortress stance makes them immovable, shield slam stuns enemies

fields.label: Warden
fields.value: Extends protective aura to allies, absorbs portion of ally damage

fields.label: Bulwark Knight
fields.value: Designates ally to protect, automatically intercepts attacks aimed at them

fields.label: Citadel
fields.value: Survives lethal damage once per battle, fights through severe injury

fields.label: Immortal Guardian
fields.value: Wide-area defensive bastion, takes drastically reduced damage

fields.label: Eternal Sentinel
fields.value: Becomes immovable wall, protects large zone, inspires allies to fight harder

name: Ren Archer — Bow Mastery Stages
subtitle: Ren Archer progression system
description: Ren Archers advance through stages of Ren-bow synchronization — how perfectly they can channel Ren through their arrows. The stages are: Novice Archer → Ren Touched → Crimson Archer → Storm Bow → Phantom Archer → Bloodshot → Arrow Sovereign. At Novice Archer, they coat arrows in basic Ren. At Arrow Sovereign, they fire with perfect accuracy while moving, create hovering arrow constructs, and imbue multiple arrows with different Ren effects.

fields.label: Stages
fields.value: Novice Archer → Ren Touched → Crimson Archer → Storm Bow → Phantom Archer → Bloodshot → Arrow Sovereign

fields.label: Novice Archer
fields.value: Basic Ren-coated arrows, increased force and penetration, rapid volley

fields.label: Ren Touched
fields.value: Power shots pierce multiple targets, armor-breaking arrows, windstep repositioning

fields.label: Crimson Archer
fields.value: Long-range precision shots, dense arrow barrages, Ren-enhanced dodging

fields.label: Storm Bow
fields.value: Enhanced vision and tracking, multiple arrow types, devastating area volleys

fields.label: Phantom Archer
fields.value: Perfect accuracy at extreme range, arrows that adjust mid-flight

fields.label: Bloodshot
fields.value: Arrows that pierce through dimensions, reality-bending Ren effects

fields.label: Arrow Sovereign
fields.value: Perfect accuracy while moving, hovering arrow constructs, multiple simultaneous Ren effects

name: Veilrunner — Shadow Mastery Tiers
subtitle: Veilrunner progression system
description: Veilrunners advance through tiers of shadow mastery — how completely they can disappear into darkness and strike without being detected. The tiers are: Nightwalker → Phantom → Ghost → Wraith → Shadow Lord → Living Shadow. At Nightwalker, they suppress sound and move quietly. At Living Shadow, they become one with the shadows, moving silently and invisibly at full speed, leaving no trace.

fields.label: Tiers
fields.value: Nightwalker → Phantom → Ghost → Wraith → Shadow Lord → Living Shadow

fields.label: Nightwalker
fields.value: Suppresses sound and moves through dim light nearly unseen, with enhanced reflexes, lock picking with Ren, and poison blade coating.

fields.label: Phantom
fields.value: High-damage backstasts, smoke screen for escape, basic disguise

fields.label: Ghost
fields.value: Full evasion mastery, Ren-enhanced dodging, vanishes for short periods

fields.label: Wraith
fields.value: Near-invisible at full speed, advanced disguise, lock touch without tools

fields.label: Shadow Lord
fields.value: Permanent shadow integration, strikes without detection, leaves no trace

fields.label: Living Shadow
fields.value: One with shadows, near-perfect stealth at full speed, vanishes indefinitely

name: Shudonkeeper — Knowledge Depths
subtitle: Shudonkeeper progression system
description: Shudonkeepers advance through depths of knowledge about the Shudon and the world core. The depths are: Student → Antiquarian → Lorekeeper → Archivist → Scholar → Sage → Core-Seer. At Student, they learn basic Shudon construction. At Core-Seer, they can sense residual world-core patterns inside Shudon remains and glimpse the true nature of the golems.

fields.label: Depths
fields.value: Student → Antiquarian → Lorekeeper → Archivist → Scholar → Sage → Core-Seer

fields.label: Student
fields.value: Learns basic Shudon construction, identifies age and origin of fragments

fields.label: Antiquarian
fields.value: Repairs inactive Shudon, reads ancient inscriptions, studies golem lore

fields.label: Lorekeeper
fields.value: Deep knowledge of Shudon creation, comprehends realm history, maintains archives

fields.label: Archivist
fields.value: Organizes all Shudon research, develops reactivation theories, senses dormant will

fields.label: Scholar
fields.value: Expert on world core's role, reads complex ancient scripts, teaches others

fields.label: Sage
fields.value: Communes with Shudon through physical contact, senses faint world-core traces

fields.label: Core-Seer
fields.value: Glimpses residual world-core patterns, deepest understanding of Shudon purpose

name: Silver Concord
subtitle: Mercenary and Contract Guild — Human Realm
description: Silver Concord is one of the most respected guilds in the Human Realm, specializing in contract mediation, mercenary dispatch, and Cross-realm trade facilitation. Founded by a B-rank Broker who saw the need for a neutral organization that could handle deals between humans, demons, and angels without bias. The guild operates out of a fortified manor in Aldermere, with branches in major cities across the Human Realm. Its reputation is built on one iron rule: every contract signed under Silver Concord's seal is honored.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mercenary and Contract Guild

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Aldermere, Human Realm (main branch)

fields.label: Founded
fields.value: Approximately 200 years ago

fields.label: Guildmaster
fields.value: Varen Ashtail — Broker class, B-rank

fields.label: Members
fields.value: ~150 active members across all ranks

fields.label: Specialization
fields.value: Contract mediation, mercenary dispatch, Cross-realm trade

fields.label: Reputation
fields.value: Known for ironclad fairness and reliable contract enforcement

fields.label: Guild Rules
fields.value: 1. Every contract under Silver Concord's seal is honored. 2. No member may break a signed contract. 3. The guild does not take sides in disputes. 4. Members protect each other. 5. The Guildmaster's word is final.

name: Silver Concord — Guild Ranks
subtitle: The adventurer ranks — metal on the badge
description: Silver Concord ranks its members by the classic metal tiers of an adventurer guild, earned through completed quests, proven skill, and a reputation the guild is willing to stand behind. The metal on a member’s badge is their record made visible — it opens doors, sets the price on their head, and decides which jobs they are trusted with. Rank is skill, not power, and not class: a Broker and a Bladesinger rise and fall by the same metal.

fields.label: Ranks
fields.value: Copper → Bronze → Iron → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Mithril → Guildmaster

fields.label: Copper
fields.value: Untested newcomers on their first jobs. Supervised on simple quests — escort work, pest clearing, courier runs.

fields.label: Bronze
fields.value: Proven enough to take standard quests alone. Handles routine monster hunts, retrieval jobs, and low-risk Cross-realm work.

fields.label: Iron
fields.value: Reliable veterans trusted with dangerous jobs and small team leads. Mentors the lower ranks between contracts.

fields.label: Silver
fields.value: Seasoned mercenaries who lead teams and take on high-stakes quests. Their name alone is worth a deposit.

fields.label: Gold
fields.value: Elite members sent on the guild’s most dangerous commissions — ruins, high-rank monsters, and sensitive retrievals.

fields.label: Platinum
fields.value: Legendary mercenaries whose deeds are recorded in the Archive. Handled ruler-level jobs and represent the guild to crowns.

fields.label: Mithril
fields.value: The rarest rank — a handful of living legends. Only they may take the guild’s unlisted, highest-risk contracts.

fields.label: Guildmaster
fields.value: A single, unique rank held by Varen Ashtail. Leads the guild and has the final word on every job, price, and dispute.

name: Silver Concord — Guild Facilities
subtitle: Guild amenities and resources
description: The Silver Concord main branch in Aldermere is a fortified manor that serves as both headquarters and meeting place. It contains all the facilities a guild needs to operate across the Human Realm.

fields.label: Contract Hall
fields.value: Central meeting room where contracts are drafted, reviewed, and sealed with the guild's magical imprint

fields.label: Training Grounds
fields.value: Indoor and outdoor areas for members to practice combat, negotiation, and contract enforcement

fields.label: Archive
fields.value: Vast library of completed contracts, legal precedents, and Cross-realm trade regulations

fields.label: Armory
fields.value: Weapons and armor available for members, including blood-forged weapons for high-rank missions

fields.label: Healing Ward
fields.value: Staffed by Clergy members, provides treatment for injured members

fields.label: Teleportation Circle
fields.value: Rare magical circle that allows fast travel to branch offices in other cities

fields.label: Guild Vault
fields.value: Secure storage for valuable contract items, rare ingredients, and guild funds

name: Varen Ashtail
subtitle: Guildmaster of Silver Concord — Broker class, B-rank
description: Varen Ashtail is the founder and Guildmaster of Silver Concord, a B-rank Broker who built the guild from nothing into one of the most respected organizations in the Human Realm. He is a tall, lean man in his late 40s with silver-streaked black hair and sharp grey eyes that miss nothing. He speaks softly but carries an air of absolute authority — the kind of man who can silence a room with a look. His specialty is high-stakes contract mediation, particularly deals involving demons and angels. He has never broken a contract in his life, and he expects the same of his members. Behind his calm exterior lies a man who has seen the worst of跨-realm politics and survived by being smarter, more prepared, and more principled than everyone around him.

name: Bella Rose
subtitle: Jaiden’s childhood friend — Archer with unusual holy energy
description: Jaiden Marlock’s childhood friend, and a Malakhim angel. She was given the class of Archer and attends Elyndor Academy. Jaiden gave her the bow Aerendrel, the Skybound Wrath. Bella was born with an unusually large reservoir of holy energy — far more than any Malakhim should possess at her age, and enough that even senior angels noticed it during her awakening at the Sundering Altar. The reason traces back to the night she was born: Jaiden Marlock, the first angel-demon hybrid, came into the world the same night. The world core’s will — which has no mind but acts to maintain balance — sensed the existence of a being who carried both angelic and demonic aura simultaneously, something the world had never seen and its balance had never accounted for. In response, the core’s will did what it always does when equilibrium is threatened: it pushed back. Not with thought, not with intent, but with a reflexive surge of purified Veyn that flooded the nearest compatible vessel — a newborn Malakhim angel lying in the same ward, in the same city, at the same moment. Bella Rose absorbed that surge without knowing it, and it settled into her Veyn channels as though it had always been there. She has never been told why her holy energy burns brighter than others of her rank. The Headmaster suspects the truth but has said nothing, because revealing it would mean revealing Jaiden’s nature — and the world core’s response to it — to people who would not understand what that balance means. Bella simply trains harder than everyone else, convinced her strength is talent rather than the world’s immune system reacting to a threat it could not name.

name: Rank and Role
subtitle: Power and profession are separate
description: A rank is a measure of power, not a profession. Every angel and demon has a rank — the amount of Veyn their body holds, shown by their wings and horns — but only some choose the army. Most angels and demons are civilians: merchants, craftsmen, scholars, laborers, and tradespeople who happen to hold a high or low rank. A powerful Aetherblade Lord Angel might command the army, or might simply be a master artisan who has never held a sword; a weak Gnash might be a soldier, or might run a shop in a quiet town. Rank decides how strong you are. Role decides what you do. And because rank is power rather than duty, angels and demons of any rank are free to leave their realm and live in the Human Realm as ordinary citizens, hiding their true nature behind Dawnveil or Duskveil.

name: The Ren Organ
subtitle: How angels and demons channel Ren
description: Angels and demons are born to Veyn — their aura, halo or miasma, and every innate skill run on it — and Ren, the inner energy drawn from a body’s own Vitality, does not come naturally to them. But it is not impossible. An angel or demon can unlock a Ren Organ: a channel within the body that lets them draw on their own Vitality and use Ren the way a human or swordsman does. The cost is absolute — while the Ren Organ is open, the user cannot touch any form of Veyn at all. The moment Veyn and Ren meet inside the same body, the incompatibility rule applies and can kill them. This means an angel or demon who walks the Ren path must fight without their aura, their halo or miasma, and every innate Veyn skill they were born with, until they close the organ and return to Veyn.

name: Rune Star Circles vs Grades
subtitle: How a Mage’s circle compares to a Grade
description: Mages do not use the Grade system — their power is measured by the Rune Star Circle inscribed into their heart. But the two scales can be compared directly by the power each tier represents. A Mage’s circle is roughly equal to a Grade as follows, starting at F because a Mage is by definition already awakened to Veyn (no Mage sits at G Grade, which means never exposed to Veyn).

name: Aldric Malgrave
subtitle: The Former King of the Human Realm
description: Aldric Malgrave was the ruler of the Human Realm before the Divina line, and the man whose fear ended a race. He looked on the Aelthar — the ancient realm-makers who could shape and tear reality itself — and saw not a people but a threat to his crown, and he hunted them to extinction. His persecution drove the survivors to tear open the Hidden Realm as a refuge, an act so violent it nearly unmade the world and forced the world core’s will to raise the barrier that split the realms apart. He caught every one of them but one — Kael von Ashen, the sole survivor who would become Headmaster of Elyndor Academy — and that single failure is the thread the whole story hangs from.
